payload.title: Alexa M7: Listen to full stories (long-form audio)
payload.description:
Milestone 7 (a follow-up after the first publication). A person can listen to a whole story, not just its summary.

Scope:
- Full-length audio per story: reuse narration audio where a site already makes it (Pilobolus), otherwise generate it with the site's chosen voice and store it on S3/CloudFront.
- Alexa AudioPlayer interface: play, pause, resume, next, previous, and playback state per user. The certification rules for audio skills apply.
- Story-level "play the latest stories" queue.

Done when: "Alexa, ask Pilobolus to play the latest story" plays the full narrated story, and pause/resume works across sessions.
